decisive_items: cystic mass in the right superior extraconal compartment
response.rationale: R1 is supported by multiple raw imaging spans (well-circumscribed extraconal mass, smooth bone remodeling, fluid-attenuating content, cystic mass, T2 hyperintensity/FLAIR hypointensity) that together define the diagnosis. C1 is an append-only completion that merely restates the same raw span already used by R1, adding no new evidence. Per instruction, correlated restatements are discounted, so R1 is the champion with high margin.

rejected.why: Append-only completion of R1 with no new raw support; the single span it cites is already present in R1's support set, making it a redundant restatement.
